"""Invoice totals."""

TAX_RATE = 0.2


def net_price(item):
    return item["unit_price"] * item["quantity"]


def gross_price(item):
    return net_price(item) * (1 + TAX_RATE)


def total_net(items):
    total = 0.0
    for item in items:
        if item.get("cancelled"):
            continue
        total += net_price(item)
    return round(total, 2)


def total_gross(items):
    total = 0.0
    for item in items:
        if item.get("cancelled"):
            continue
        total += gross_price(item)
    return round(total, 2)
